title: DevOps Software Engineering Intern
description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact
Immerse yourself in the dynamic and innovative world of DevOps as a Software Engineering Undergraduate Intern at Intel. In this role, you will contribute to building and optimizing software development infrastructure, focusing on automation, monitoring, integration, and deployment workflows. Your hands-on work will directly enhance the scalability and reliability of Intel's software solutions, ensuring smoother collaboration across teams and streamlined development processes.
Business group
You'll be joining Intel's Data Center Group (DCG), a key part of Intel's mission to drive innovation in computing and data management. DCG focuses on delivering advanced solutions that power data centers, cloud services, and AI-driven technologies. As part of this group, you will gain experience in areas that are central to transforming how businesses operate and solve complex challenges globally.
Key Responsibilities
- Support software development infrastructure by maintaining and enhancing automation tools and processes.
- Assist in monitoring and optimizing workflows to ensure seamless integration across software engineering, IT, and operations teams.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to contribute to CI/CD setup, cloud integration, and containerization efforts.
- Participate in deployment workflows to improve software reliability and scalability.
- Explore innovative approaches to streamline development and release processes.
- Gain hands-on experience with technical tools and methodologies that align with Intel's business goals.
Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
- Pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field with 1+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, software engineering, or infrastructure management, with demonstrated skills gained through internships, academic projects, coursework, or hands-on training.
- Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g. Python, Bash) and version control systems (e.g. Git).
- Basic debugging skills.
- Exposure to CI/CD tools, containerization platforms (e.g., Docker), or cloud services.
Preferred Qualifications
- Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively across teams.
- Solid problem solving skills.
- Knowledge of software development practices and software testing methodologies.
- Interest in learning and applying innovative technologies to solve real-world problems.
- Passion for contributing to scalable and reliable infrastructure solutions.
We encourage you to bring your curiosity and enthusiasm to Intel, where you will gain valuable exposure, grow your technical expertise, and explore future opportunities in a collaborative and forward-thinking environment. Apply today and take the next step toward building your career in a supportive and innovative team.
